name: XFT Content Action Bar
summary: Container-width XFT boundary and background for consumer-provided actions in a non-overlay workspace bottom dock.

useWhen: page-level actions should remain available while workspace content scrolls
avoidWhen: actions are global, selection-scoped, row-local, or do not need a persistent page-level region

properties.name: children
properties.description: Actions and layout supplied by the consumer.

properties.name: ariaLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the toolbar region.

consumerProvides: business handlers, loading, and disabled state
doesNotOwn: dock host width or horizontal position
guidance: Place it inside a consumer-owned bottom-dock host when actions must remain available while content scrolls.
limitations: It does not accept positioning, alignment, business-state, className, or style props.
